rulings: R-i a spine's second sentence carries a noun from its first regardless of k; R-ii a negated surface on a PRESENT read is not an absence opener (one per variant); R-iii 'asks little of' is not the threat read, the ledger states the threat over the country; R-iv the [unfolding] variant realises OPEN (the shortfall standing open now) after the wall's presence; R-vi the office's formula (entered, on the roll, carried standing) is lawful, the roll as agent-source (the roll shows, the roll sets down) is refused; R-viii on WALLED-STRAINED only, the engine's asymmetry is licensed as one face of variant 2: the wall's standing needs no pay and the muster's does (e.g. 'The {defwork} keeps itself, and the muster's wages do not.'); W1 possessor binding (the town's muster / the muster, never 'its muster' after a {defwork} subject); W2 the threat is country-scoped, never a totality over the town; W3 the band carries its marker (village size or under; a town or larger); W4 the construction contract per variant is kept; W5 'the town of {settlement}' is the naming form, a band is stated as a band; W6 no doubled beat; W8 the visitor carries the gate only as the wall's standing state (kept at full cost), never the town's act or an accounts fact; W10 one negated opener per variant.

targets.quote: The threat is live. {settlement} holds a {defwork}, and its upkeep is met to the last.
targets.finding: R-i: the second sentence carries no noun from the first (the thread)
targets.cure: carry the threat or the country forward into the second sentence, or fold the two into one; keep all three reads

targets.quote: At {settlement} the money holds and the {defwork} holds, and danger is in the country.
targets.finding: 'the {defwork} holds' beside the named danger reads as withstanding (a second fact); the triad shape
targets.cure: a verb for the work that cannot mean withstanding; two clauses, not three

targets.quote: The {defwork} at {settlement} stands whole in its keeping, and the country around is dangerous.
targets.finding: 'whole' is a seen particular of the fabric no field holds (the visitor fence)
targets.cure: the keeping stated without a condition word on the fabric; the numbered [visitor] line, opening off the proper slot

targets.quote: The country is dangerous. {settlement} is enclosed, and its {defwork} is kept at full cost.
targets.finding: R-i: the second sentence hands no noun back to the first
targets.cure: keep '{settlement} is enclosed' and 'kept at full cost'; carry the country or the danger into the second sentence

targets.quote: The cost of the {defwork} at {settlement} is met entire, and danger holds in the country.
targets.finding: an accounts fact under the visitor tag (dropped angle); the construction of v1 f2 with nouns swapped; 'met entire' costume
targets.cure: the gate as the wall's standing state in the visitor's mouth (the model: kept at full cost), a construction no sibling face uses

targets.quote: Danger is live in the country, and {settlement} pays the whole cost of its {defwork}.
targets.finding: the town's act under the visitor tag (dropped angle)
targets.cure: the wall's standing state as seen, not the town's paying; three reads; lands on the work or the country

targets.quote: Nothing live threatens {settlement}, and the {defwork} the town keeps up stands.
targets.finding: W2: a town-scoped totality over every threat class (C7 against DS-DEF-2)
targets.cure: country-scoped; the draft's v1 f2 is available with its fronted opener, the that-relative and 'standing' cut

targets.quote: A {defwork} has standing at {settlement}, kept up by the town, and nothing live is abroad in the country.
targets.finding: 'nothing live is abroad' elides the head noun (a claim over the country's creatures); 'has standing' is a legal idiom misused
targets.cure: the head noun restored (no live threat in the country); a plain presence verb; the draft's v1 f3 is available but its 'A {defwork} stands at {settlement}' frame is shared with two sibling pools, so prefer another opener

targets.quote: The upkeep of the {defwork} at {settlement} is met, and it stands. The country is settled.
targets.finding: 'it' is ambiguous (the upkeep, the wall, the town); 'settled' reads as a geography word; the second sentence turns with nothing carried (R-i)
targets.cure: the wall named, the country's quiet stated in the country's terms without 'settled', the thread carried; the draft's v2 f1 is available minus 'nothing is short' (STRAINED's flip)

targets.quote: No live threat presses {settlement}. The {defwork} it keeps stands, and nothing of the keeping is left aside.
targets.finding: W2 town-scoped; reproduces v1 f2's frame with a pronoun swap (spread flattened)
targets.cure: country-scoped and a construction of its own; the draft's v2 f3 is available with 'is standing' and the flat close sharpened

targets.quote: The town asks little of its {defwork}, and its upkeep is paid whole; the work stands entered on the roll.
targets.finding: R-iii: 'asks little of' is a usage frame, the threat read is not stated
targets.cure: state the quiet over the country in the ledger's stance; keep 'stands entered on the roll' (the office's formula is lawful, R-vi); the numbered [ledger] line

targets.quote: On the roll the {defwork} is carried standing, its upkeep met in full, and nothing live lies against the town.
targets.finding: 'lies against the town' is a books idiom (a charge) and town-scoped (W2)
targets.cure: country-scoped, no books idiom; 'On the roll … carried standing' is lawful surface and may stay

targets.quote: Little is asked of the {defwork}. The roll shows the work standing, and its keeping met.
targets.finding: R-iii the threat read unstated; R-vi 'The roll shows' makes the roll the source
targets.cure: the threat stated over the country; the office's formula instead of the roll as agent; a construction unlike f0 and f1

targets.quote: The roll sets down the {defwork} standing and its upkeep paid, and the country is quiet.
targets.finding: R-vi 'The roll sets down' makes the roll the agent-source
targets.cure: keep 'the country is quiet' (the key's own word, the lawful contrast with THREATENED's 'not quiet'); the entry stated in the office's formula without the roll as agent

targets.quote: A {defwork} stands at {settlement}. Its muster's pay is short.
targets.finding: W1: sentence-initial 'Its' binds to the {defwork}, the wall's muster (the shipped watch by another route)
targets.cure: one word: 'The muster's pay is short.' or 'The town's muster is short of its pay.'

targets.quote: In place at {settlement} is a {defwork}, and the upkeep of its muster is unmet.
targets.finding: W1: 'its muster' is the wall's
targets.cure: 'the upkeep of the town's muster is unmet' or 'the muster's upkeep is unmet'

targets.quote: A {defwork} is entered standing at {settlement}, and the funding of its muster is short of the wage.
targets.finding: W1 possessor; 'is entered standing' is heavy and shared with QUIET's ledger; shares its first clause shape with f1
targets.cure: the town as possessor; a construction unlike f1 (a different subject or order); the roll or the wage as the standard

targets.quote: The {defwork} at {settlement} stands, and the muster's pay is short of the roll.
targets.finding: R-iv: built as the ledger's measure-against-the-roll under the [unfolding] tag (dropped angle)
targets.cure: the OPEN realisation after the wall's presence: the shortfall as a matter standing open now (stands open; stands unmet; is owed); the numbered [unfolding] line, opening on 'The {defwork}' as this variant owns

targets.quote: A {defwork} is in place at {settlement}, and the town's muster is paid under its wage.
targets.finding: 'paid under its wage' asserts a positive share (a rate of pay), which the gate does not hold
targets.cure: the shortfall without a share: the draft's 'and the pay of the town's muster is short' is clean

targets.quote: At {settlement} a {defwork} is up. Its muster's upkeep stands open.
targets.finding: W1: sentence-initial 'Its' binds to the {defwork}
targets.cure: 'The muster's upkeep stands open.' (stands open survives; it is the pool's best second beat)

targets.quote: A {defwork} at {settlement} is the town's, and its muster's funding is under the roll.
targets.finding: a paraphrase of f0 (same subject, order, joint, landing noun); 'under the roll' reads as a heading
targets.cure: R-viii: seat the engine's asymmetry here as the writer's own sentence on exactly that fact (the wall's standing needs no pay, the muster's does; e.g. 'The {defwork} keeps itself, and the muster's wages do not.'); a different subject, order and landing noun from f0

targets.quote: The measure of {settlement} stops at a village, and it carries no wall.
targets.finding: 'it' binds to the measure (the LACK reaches the town only by repair)
targets.cure: the draft face is clean: 'and the place carries no wall'

targets.quote: At {settlement} the size keeps to a village and no higher. The place stands unwalled.
targets.finding: W6: 'and no higher' restates the ceiling already stated
targets.cure: the draft face is clean: drop 'and no higher'

targets.quote: Village size holds at {settlement} and no wall stands.
targets.finding: W3: the band marker dropped, reads as the tier value 'village' (contradicts thorp and hamlet)
targets.cure: the marker restored ('Village size or under holds at {settlement}') or another band form

targets.quote: What stands at {settlement} is no larger than a village, and no wall shows.
targets.finding: W4: variant 1's construction (subject, is + band, comma-and, no wall as its own clause); the pool's two grammars collapsed to one
targets.cure: the place as subject with one compound predicate (the two reads in one clause): the draft's 'stands no larger than a village and shows no wall' minus 'The whole of'; the numbered [visitor] line, opening off the proper slot

targets.quote: A village is the most {settlement} comes to. The place holds no wall.
targets.finding: the second sentence is v1 f2's second sentence with the verb swapped (spread)
targets.cure: keep 'A village is the most {settlement} comes to' (the set's best band phrasing); the LACK in the visitor's syntax of noticing, not 'The place holds/stands'

targets.quote: The size at {settlement} does not pass a village, nor is a wall up.
targets.finding: W4: the measure-subject belongs to [street]; this face crosses the contract
targets.cure: the place as subject, a compound predicate; 'nor is a wall up' may stay as the second predicate's shape

targets.quote: The town of {settlement}'s weight stands without a circuit.
targets.finding: W5: the naming-form article makes the weight the subject; with 'A' the frame is a maxim
targets.cure: a construction that states the band as a band with the ledger's 'weight' and no naming-form article; both reads; closes on the circuit or the town; the numbered [ledger] line (v1 f0 does not open on the proper slot, so this line may)

targets.quote: Ranked a town or larger, {settlement} holds no circuit.
targets.finding: the spine's frame to the word class (fronted band adjunct, comma, the slot, a short verb, no, the wall-noun) with vocabulary swapped
targets.cure: a different subject, order or landing noun from variant 1's numbered line
